title: Standing grant: a lane opens its own draft PR
why: Owner 17:10 CST Nov 12, after lane cloud-hooks-stale-copy stopped to ask before opening its draft PR: "yes open the draft PR ... but kinda a problem no". The cloud default says no PR unless the user asks, and claude-settings .claude/CLAUDE.md has no grant line, so a lane that reads it literally stalls.
note: Settled, no owner item: decision draft-until-reviewed (owner 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-13) already rules that every PR opens as a draft and lane PRs stay drafts; only the integration PR goes ready. Land it as a Standing grants line in .claude/CLAUDE.md citing that decision: any lane that a coordinator or lane started may open its own draft PR and never marks it ready. Degen carries the same grant (its item 161 a). Owner 17:10 CST yes covers cloud-hooks-stale-copy's PR now. Coordinator 17:13 CST Nov 12: not started; auto mode refused its create_session as Self-Modification (brief edits .claude/CLAUDE.md). Owner task item 668 asks for the typed `go lane-draft-pr-grant` in the coordinator chat; the coordinator starts the lane on it. Owner typed `go lane-draft-pr-grant` 17:18 CST Nov 12 (item 668 closed) and said "A for sure" 17:19 CST (retrospective relay): cite owner 2026-11-12 17:19 CST beside decision draft-until-reviewed. Lane session_013NEJL258aTLwZqrm5UsXdf (record-writer, Sonnet medium) started 17:19 CST. Retrospective asks it run express: a ruled prose change (R59 part 5).
